ProgressOut.description: Counts of finished units. Deliberately not a percentage or a time estimate.
ProgressOut.title: ProgressOut

patch.description: Move, resize or retype a balloon. `version` must match (409 version_conflict if not).

post.description:
Start Checkout. A repeated request with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same
session; a subscription is refused while one is already live (use the portal).

delete.description:
Delete the account and all of its comics, images and exports.

The account is blocked immediately; cancellation, draining, verified content deletion,
subscription cancellation and identity deletion then run as a durable job (finished
by the maintenance loop if anything is still in progress).

get.description: Public product catalog: styles, limits and credit prices.

post.description: Instruction-based edit ("make her smile") of the current image.
New version from the same spec with a new seed. Costs credits only if it delivers.
Create a comic from a prompt. Reserves planning credits and starts the workflow.

get.description: Full project state: bible, cast, script, pages, exports and measured progress.

post.description: Answer (or skip, with an empty object) the clarifying questions.
Approve one exact cast version. A stale version returns 409 version_conflict.

get.description: Credits the next paid step will hold. Shown before the user approves spending.

Server-sent progress events. Resumes from `Last-Event-ID` (or `?after=`); events are
persisted, so anything missed while disconnected is replayed in order. If the requested
position is older than retained history a `reset` event tells the client to refetch.

post.description: Export an immutable snapshot of the comic as PDF, PNG or CBZ.
Recover a failed, expired or partially completed comic from its last durable stage.

patch.description: Save an edited script as a new version. Invalidates any earlier approval.

post.description: Approve one exact script version, hold illustration credits and start drawing.
